articles.summary: A new MedTech Dive article covers Labcorp’s expansion of its collaboration with PathAI to implement the FDA-cleared AISight® Dx digital pathology platform across its U.S. its national network of anatomic pathology labs and hospital collaborations.
articles.title: MedTech Dive: Labcorp Scales Digital Pathology Through Expanded PathAI Collaboration

articles.summary: A new article on GenomeWeb highlights Labcorp’s expanded collaboration with Illumina to broaden access to precision oncology testing through new distributed offerings and co commercialized genomic test solutions.
articles.title: GenomeWeb: Labcorp and Illumina Expand Precision Oncology Collaboration
